name: omc-runs
description: One row above the prompt per active oh-my-claudecode mode in this session (autopilot, ralph, team, ultragoal): its phase, iteration, workers or goal, elapsed time and running agents, with a warning in the same row when the run is stale, looping or awaiting confirmation. /omc-runs prints the plan file, last phase change and cancel command. Read only; hidden when no mode is active. Supersedes omc-watchdog.

staleHours.title: Stale after (hours)
staleHours.description: An active mode whose state has not been touched for longer than this carries the stale warning. OMC itself treats state older than 2 hours as stale. A value of 0 or less uses 2.

reinforcementLimit.title: Looping at reinforcement count
reinforcementLimit.description: Overrides the reinforcement_count at which an active mode carries the looping warning. 0 uses the ceilings OMC itself enforces: 20 for autopilot and team, max_reinforcements (default 50) for ultragoal. ralph is judged by its iteration nearing OMC's hard limit (450 of 500, or 180 of 200 with OMC_SECURITY=strict) either way.
